description_en: Queries the compliance evaluation results of a rule
description_zh: 从规则维度查询规则对资源的评估结果
kebab_example: aliyun config list-config-rule-evaluation-results --compliance-type NON_COMPLIANT --next-token IWBjqMYSy0is7zSMGu160000 --max-results 10 --config-rule-id cr-cac56457e0d900d30000 --compliance-pack-id cp-f1e3326622af00cb0000 --regions cn-shanghai --resource-types ACS::ECS::Instance --resource-group-ids rg-aek2indxn3g0000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListConfigRuleEvaluationResults

parameters.help_en:
The compliance evaluation result. Valid values:

COMPLIANT: The resource is compliant.

NON_COMPLIANT: The resource is non-compliant.

NOT_APPLICABLE: The rule does not apply to the resource.

INSUFFICIENT_DATA: No data is available.

IGNORED: The evaluation result is ignored
parameters.help_zh:
合规评估结果。取值：
COMPLIANT：合规。
NON_COMPLIANT：不合规。
NOT_APPLICABLE：不适用。
INSUFFICIENT_DATA：无数据。
IGNORED：已忽略
parameters.name: compliance_type

parameters.help_en: If the response is truncated, use the `NextToken` to retrieve the next page of results
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用`NextToken`再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 单次请求返回结果的最大条数。取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The rule ID.

For more information about how to obtain a rule ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169607.html
parameters.help_zh:
规则ID。

关于如何获取规则ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169607.html
parameters.name: config_rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The compliance package ID.

For more information about how to obtain a compliance package ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/263332.html
parameters.help_zh:
合规包ID。

关于如何获取合规包ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/263332.html
parameters.name: compliance_pack_id

parameters.help_en: The region where the evaluated resource resides. Separate multiple regions with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 评估资源所属地域，多个地域之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: regions

parameters.help_en: The type of the evaluated resource. Separate multiple resource types with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 评估资源的资源类型，多个资源类型之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: resource_types

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the evaluated resource belongs. Separate multiple resource group IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 评估资源所属的资源组ID，多个资源组ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: resource_group_ids

EvaluationResultList.description_en: The list of rule evaluation results

Annotation.description_en:
The supplementary information about the non-compliant resource. This may include the following information:

`configuration`: The current configuration of the resource, which is the non-compliant configuration.

`desiredValue`: The expected configuration of the resource, which is the compliant configuration.

`operator`: The comparison operator used to compare the current configuration with the expected configuration.

`property`: The JSON path of the current configuration in the resource property struct.

`reason`: The reason why the resource is non-compliant
Annotation.description_zh:
不合规资源的补充信息。可能包含以下信息：

`configuration`：资源当前实际配置，即资源不合规配置。
`desiredValue`：资源期望配置，即资源合规配置。
`operator`：资源当前配置和期望配置之间的比较运算符。
`property`：当前配置在资源属性结构体中的JSON路径。
`reason`：资源不合规原因

The compliance evaluation result. Valid values:

COMPLIANT: The resource is compliant.

NON_COMPLIANT: The resource is non-compliant.

IGNORED: The evaluation result is ignored
ComplianceType.description_zh:

COMPLIANT：合规。
NON_COMPLIANT：不合规。
NOT_APPLICABLE：不适用。
INSUFFICIENT_DATA：无数据。
IGNORED：已忽略

IgnoreDate.description_en:
The date when the ignored evaluation result is automatically resumed.

If this parameter is empty, the result is not automatically resumed. You must manually resume it

已忽略评估结果的自动恢复日期。

为空表示不会自动恢复，需要您手动恢复
